errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of win rates across four large language models, GPT-4o, GPT-40, Mistral, and LLaMA.
errors.evidence: The figure is a nested doughnut chart showing two separate pairwise comparisons (GPT-4o vs Mistral and GPT-4o vs LLaMA), not a single pie chart showing a single distribution across four models.
The chart does not contain a model named "GPT-40". It shows two results for "GPT-4o" in two different comparisons. The model has misinterpreted this as a separate model.

errors.text_span: colored in a dark blue, representing GPT-4o at approximately 96.8%, followed by GPT-40 at 98.4%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly orders the slices. The 98.4% slice is larger than the 96.8% slice, so it would not come 'followed by' in a descending order. Furthermore, these two slices belong to two different comparisons (the inner and outer rings), not a single sequence.
The chart clearly labels the value for Mistral as 1.2%, not 9.8%.

errors.text_span: The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice
errors.evidence: The percentage labels are located outside the doughnut chart, with leader lines pointing to the respective slices.

errors.text_span: The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in size
errors.evidence: This is false. The description itself lists the values in a non-ordered sequence (96.8%, 98.4%, 9.8%, 3.2%). The actual values are also not arranged in a simple descending order around the chart, as they belong to two different rings.
